title: bind_interaction inputSchema
description: Argument shape for bind_interaction (interactivity profile, ADR-0030). Adds or replaces (by interaction id) one declarative event→action binding in a Map or App document. The standard-level target is a Map or App document (mapId or appId). The reference implementation authors compositions through a draft lifecycle; its optimistic-concurrency draft spelling (draftId + generation) is admitted as x-honua-reference-shape, consistent with ADR-0029's admission of reference spellings. Validation gate: the interaction's on.ref and do.ref must resolve to components declared in the target document, and the per-(on.ref, on.event) fan-out cap applies (recommended 8). See docs/adr/0030-declarative-interactions-and-layout.md and common/interactions.schema.json. Exactly one target must be supplied: mapId, appId, or the x-honua-reference-shape draftId (which requires generation). The oneOf below enforces that; without it a call with no target, with both package ids, or with draftId and no generation validated against a contract no server can route.

mapId.description: Target Map document. Exactly one of mapId / appId / draftId identifies the target.

appId.description: Target App document. Exactly one of mapId / appId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

interaction.description: The binding to add or replace. Replacement matches on interaction.id.
